_doc: The charter goals of a new town's first days (Systems/Goals.cs): an ordered list, `shown` open at a time. A goal is met when its measure reaches its target; it pays its small reward once (gold, mandate, festival days of good cheer) and the next one shows. A goal with `gain` counts only what is added after it shows. Measures: households, tier (0 thorp, 1 hamlet, 2 village), built:<building id>, painted:<Zone> (whole tiles of that zone, built on or not), watch (watchmen, a watch house counting as one), or any tutorial measure (count:<Town list>, zoned...). Past `lapse` days the list closes unfinished, quietly. Keep rewards small: the stand-in mayor meets these too.

goals.text: Raise the hamlet charter (30 households, a tavern, 60 gold)
goals.label: Charter

goals.text: Raise a granary for the village charter
goals.label: Granaries
